featured_reviews.name: Shailesh Somani
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Shirdi Saibaba Temple, located at Shirdi, Maharashtra, India attracts millions of devotees of all religions, castes and creed who come to pay homage to Shri Sai Baba. The temple is a beautiful shrine that was built over the Samadhi of Shri Sai Baba.

Shirdi is a small village in Kopargam taluk, in Ahmadnagar District of the Maharastra State. When Baba was physically present at the age of 20 in Shirdi, Shirdi was a small village of about 70/80 houses of mud walls. Today Shirdi is a big town with modern buildings, hotels, lodges and shops.

Thursday is the day Saibaba is specially worshipped. On this day devotees from all over India visit Shirdi for Darshan of Saibaba.

Sai temple shirdi opens for devotees at 5.15 a.m. (0515 hrs) with Kakad Aarti and remains open till the end of Shejarti.

Jalaram Mandir holds a very special place in my heart. It is one of the oldest mandirs in my area, and I have literally grown up visiting this temple. The peaceful atmosphere and divine vibes make it feel like home every time I step inside.
One of the most beautiful memories connected to this mandir is the bandara. I have grown up eating bandara here and the taste, simplicity and love with which it is served make it truly special. It’s not just food it’s prasad filled with devotion and warmth.

Jalaram Mandir is more than a place of worship for me. it’s a part of my childhood, faith and memories. A truly blessed and timeless place. 🙏✨

featured_reviews.review_text:
The entire temple is exceptionally clean and well-maintained, which immediately fills you with positivity. The idol of Shree Gajanan Maharaj is deeply serene and spiritually powerful. The calm expression on Shri Gajanan Maharaj’s face radiates compassion, strength, and reassurance, instantly filling the heart with devotion and peace. The divine atmosphere brings a deep sense of calm and gratitude.
The people managing the temple and the devotees are very kind, disciplined, and helpful, making the darshan experience smooth and fulfilling. The charitable services and seva initiatives are beautifully organized and reflect true selfless service. You leave the temple with a light heart, positive energy, and a sense of inner peace. Truly a blessed place to visit. 🙏✨

description:
DAILY AARTI TIMINGS - (Morning 9:00 am
Afternoon 12:30 pm
Night 9:00 pm)
Suvarna Temple is also known as "Shree Mahashesha Rundamalini Temple" or "Nine Mother Children Temple" and is indeed a unique temple in its own. Located amidst the beauty of Powai this temple has lot of serenity and calm. The ‘Nine Mother Children’ temple is one of the oldest holy places in Powai. This temple was evolved in 1957, but the prathista and other ritual ceremony were performed on 1963. Here you can find all the almighties from all the communities-Hindus, Muslim, Chirstian. So the restriction is not imparted on any caste to enter inside the premises. Here all the caste and religion are treated one and the same.

featured_reviews.name: arti mogadpally
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Suvarna Naga Temple in Powai was a deeply peaceful and spiritually uplifting experience. Tucked away amidst greenery and the calm surroundings of Powai, the temple offers a soothing escape from the noise and rush of city life. As soon as I entered the temple premises, I felt a sense of serenity and positive energy.
The temple is dedicated to Lord Suvarna Naga, and the idol is beautifully adorned, reflecting devotion and purity. The architecture is simple yet graceful, allowing devotees to focus entirely on prayer and meditation. The priests perform the rituals with great dedication, and they patiently guide devotees through the puja process, explaining its significance.
What touched me the most was the calm atmosphere inside the temple. The sound of bells, chants, and incense created a spiritually charged environment that helped me feel connected and grounded. Many devotees visit the temple seeking relief from Naga dosha and for overall well-being, and the faith here feels strong and genuine.
Overall, my visit to Suvarna Naga Temple, Powai, was a fulfilling experience. It left me with inner peace, positivity, and a sense of gratitude. I would highly recommend this temple to anyone looking for spiritual solace and divine blessings in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Ashwin Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nestled in a serene and peaceful environment, Geetambika Temple Vidyavihar is a divine sanctuary that offers a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. The temple's peaceful surroundings create an ideal atmosphere for prayer, meditation, and reflection, making it a must-visit destination for those seeking inner peace.

One of the highlights of this sacred place is the Maha Aarti held every Friday evening, a special occasion where devotees gather to experience the divine vibrations of the aarti, which fills the air with spirituality and devotion. The atmosphere during the aarti is electric with positive energy, making it a truly soul-enriching experience for all who attend.

The temple is also home to a team of dedicated pandits who perform a variety of poojas and religious rituals. These pandits ensure that the temple remains a vibrant hub of spiritual activity, offering blessings and guidance to all visitors. Whether it's daily prayers, special occasions, or personal requests, the pandits are always available to conduct poojas to fulfill the devotees' spiritual needs.

A visit to Geetambika Temple Vidyavihar is more than just a religious experience; it's a chance to connect with the divine in a peaceful and harmonious environment. Whether you come for the Friday evening Maha Aarti or for a quiet moment of reflection, this temple offers a space to renew your spirit and seek blessings
